app.headline: Pharmacy operating software, built for Egypt
app.lede: Lot-accurate inventory, pharmacist-gated dispensing, fast POS and supplier automation. In discovery with pharmacists now; pilot planned for month 13.
caps: Drug master with brand-to-ingredient mapping, regulatory flags and effective-dated price history.
Receive by lot, suggest first-expiry-first-out at the till, block expired, recalled or quarantined lots.
Paper, Kiorly e-Rx (with patient consent) or Kiorex upload; interaction checks and pharmacist sign-off on every Rx.
Barcode sales in under 3 seconds, split tender, returns, shift close and Z-report.
Purchase orders, credit, auto-reorder suggestions and cross-branch recall blocks.
Phase 2: accept orders against accurate available-to-promise stock.
app.safety: Expiry and recall blocks, prescription checks, controlled-medicine logging and pharmacist sign-off are on in every edition and cannot be switched off.
app.footer: Kiorly by Kiorex. Skeleton build: no clinical or inventory data is processed.
